selection: The five-character lineup in references/91781.png defines the inclusion set; the six contact sheets are supporting structure references.

review.notes: Five standalone 1254px renders preserve the selected lineup identities, use one characteristic hue, retain clear material/characteristic separation, and remove contact-sheet dividers and neighboring figures.

isolation.method: The accepted studio render was regenerated without identity or geometry changes on a flat magenta background, then converted to RGBA with the imagegen remove_chroma_key helper using border auto-key, soft matte, thresholds 12/220, and despill.
isolation.reason: Chroma isolation preserves pale ceramic limbs and shell edges that overlap the warm plaster background in the studio renders.
